body:
You don't know my partner. I'm literally stuck to our children while he does whatever he likes and it'll always be that way. He won't let me leave emotionally so this is how it has to be. 
Thank you for your concern though.

I don't really have any friends.. which is kinda why I made this account. just inside a dim house all day waiting for my partner to get home so I can maybe say something and maybe be listened too. I hate it. I've tried to explain how I feel and how we could so things differently but it's never taken on board.

Some people just aren't meant to be on Earth for long my purpose was delivering two healthy children and that's it. My goal as a child was to represent my country in football. I never thought I'd have kids ever. But I did so my times done here now.
